```{r}
library(AER)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
# 11.24a
# 估計 lprice 的簡化式迴歸模型
# 解釋變數包含所有的外生變數 (星期虛擬變數) 以及工具變數 (stormy, mixed)
eq_red <- lm(lprice ~ mon + tue + wed + thu + stormy + mixed, data = fultonfish)

# 檢視迴歸結果，觀察 mixed 的 p-value
summary(eq_red)

# 檢定 stormy 和 mixed 的聯合顯著性 (F-test)
linearHypothesis(eq_red, c("stormy = 0", "mixed = 0"))
```

```{r}
# 11.24b
# 使用 AER::ivreg 執行 2SLS
eq_demand_iv <- ivreg(lquan ~ lprice + mon + tue + wed + thu | 
                              stormy + mixed + mon + tue + wed + thu, 
                      data = fultonfish)

summary(eq_demand_iv)
```

```{r}
# 11.24c
summary(eq_demand_iv, diagnostics = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# 11.24d
linearHypothesis(eq_red, c("mon = 0", "tue = 0", "wed = 0", "thu = 0"))
```
```{r}
# 11.28b
# 1. 估計反需求方程式 (Inverse Demand)
# 公式：應變數 ~ 內生變數 + 外生變數 | 工具變數 + 外生變數
inv_demand_2sls <- ivreg(p ~ q + ps + di | pf + ps + di, data = truffles)
summary(inv_demand_2sls)

# 2. 估計反供給方程式 (Inverse Supply)
inv_supply_2sls <- ivreg(p ~ q + pf | ps + di + pf, data = truffles)
summary(inv_supply_2sls)
```
```{r}
# 11.28c
# 計算樣本平均值
mean_p <- mean(truffles$p)
mean_q <- mean(truffles$q)

# 提取 Q 的係數 (gamma_2)
gamma2 <- coef(inv_demand_2sls)["q"]

# 計算彈性
elasticity <- (1 / gamma2) * (mean_p / mean_q)
cat("在平均值處的需求價格彈性為:", round(elasticity, 4), "\n")
```
```{r}
# 11.28d
# 設定外生變數給定值
DI_star <- 3.5
PF_star <- 23
PS_star <- 22

# 計算需求曲線的截距與斜率
# P = (gamma1 + gamma3*PS + gamma4*DI) + gamma2*Q
int_D <- coef(inv_demand_2sls)["(Intercept)"] + 
         coef(inv_demand_2sls)["ps"] * PS_star + 
         coef(inv_demand_2sls)["di"] * DI_star
slope_D <- coef(inv_demand_2sls)["q"]

# 計算供給曲線的截距與斜率
# P = (delta1 + delta3*PF) + delta2*Q
int_S <- coef(inv_supply_2sls)["(Intercept)"] + 
         coef(inv_supply_2sls)["pf"] * PF_star
slope_S <- coef(inv_supply_2sls)["q"]

# 使用 ggplot2 繪圖
ggplot(data.frame(Q = c(0, 30)), aes(x = Q)) +
  stat_function(fun = function(q) int_D + slope_D * q, aes(color = "Demand"), linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = function(q) int_S + slope_S * q, aes(color = "Supply"), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Truffle Market: Supply and Demand",
       x = "Quantity (Q)",
       y = "Price (P)",
       color = "Curve") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Demand" = "blue", "Supply" = "red"))
```
```{r}
# 11.28e
# 1. 聯立求解 (d) 中的兩條直線
# int_D + slope_D * Q = int_S + slope_S * Q
Q_eq <- (int_D - int_S) / (slope_S - slope_D)
P_eq <- int_S + slope_S * Q_eq

cat("從結構式(Structural form)推導的均衡數量 Q* =", round(Q_eq, 4), "\n")
cat("從結構式(Structural form)推導的均衡價格 P* =", round(P_eq, 4), "\n\n")

# 2. 估計簡化式 (Reduced-form equations) 並預測
# 簡化式是將 P 和 Q 分別對「所有」外生變數做 OLS 迴歸
red_q <- lm(q ~ ps + di + pf, data = truffles)
red_p <- lm(p ~ ps + di + pf, data = truffles)

# 建立給定外生變數的預測資料框
newdata_star <- data.frame(ps = PS_star, di = DI_star, pf = PF_star)

# 進行預測
pred_Q <- predict(red_q, newdata = newdata_star)
pred_P <- predict(red_p, newdata = newdata_star)

cat("從簡化式(Reduced-form)預測的均衡數量 Q* =", round(pred_Q, 4), "\n")
cat("從簡化式(Reduced-form)預測的均衡價格 P* =", round(pred_P, 4), "\n")
```
